name: comp-361
title: Stats Tooltip
blurb: A tooltip showing stats in a two-column label/value grid.
description: Tooltip displaying a list of metric names on the left and their values on the right in a compact grid format.
use_when: Showing deployment status, code metrics, or any multi-stat summary in a compact tooltip.
avoid_when: Very long stat names or many rows; content can overflow.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; tooltip is shown via hover only.
